To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

GFI1 and 1b are essential for the endothelial-to-hematopoietic trans-differentiation that occurs in the embryonic aorta-gonad-mesonephros region, and that GFI proteins recruit LSD1 to silence endothelial genes during this process.
GFI1 and 1b proteins are required for HSC generation in the AGM region through recruitment of the chromatin-modifier LSD1.
GFI1 and 1b proteins recruit LSD1 to epigenetically reprogram haemogenic endothelial cells to generate blood stem cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the transcriptional program that orchestrates EHT and reveals that the GFI1-LSD1 repressive complex is essential for the establishment of haematopoiesis in vertebrates.
the identification of the transcriptional network that drives the endothelial-to-hematopoietic trans-differentiation.
the molecular mechanisms underlying the emergence of blood stem cells in vertebrates, a fundamental biological question with important clinical implications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
GFI1 is an essential factor in the emergence of the first HSCs in vertebrates.
GFI1 and LSD1 proteins orchestrate HSC emergence by epigenetically silencing the endothelial program and activating a haematopoietetic program in HE.
GFI1 and its partner, LSD1, are critical regulators of EHT and HSC emergence.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
GFI1 orchestrates the emergence of HSCs through the epigenetic silencing of the endothelial program and the activation of a haematopoietically poised program in haemogenic endothelial cells.
the transcription factors GFI1 and 1b orchestrate the emergence and function of HSCs through the recruitment of LSD1 to repress endothelial genes.
GFI1 and its partner LSD1 are essential to repress endothelial genes and promote HSC generation from HE.
The main takeaway from our work is that
GFI1 and LSD1 orchestrate the emergence and the epigenetic silencing of the endothelial program during EHT.
the transcriptional repressor GFI1 proteins are essential for the emergence of HSCs through the recruitment of LSD1 and the epigenetic repression of endothelial genes.
GFI1 and its partner LSD1 are key regulators of the EHT and the generation of HSCs.
